**Scorchbeast Queen**

The Scorchbeast Queen has two loot pools.

The first loot pool has a 20% chance to be the Scorchbeast meat part that you want.

The second loot pool has a 36% chance to be the Scorchbeast meat part that you want.

This means she will always drop two Scorchbeast Pieces. It could be a liver and a lung one time or two pieces of meat the next time.

__Farming Tips and Tricks__

The following perk cards, magazines, and/or backpack mods will increase your yields.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5378e355d33745d1a2b036b37f446eb6~mv2.jpg)

__Vendors and Camp Allies__

Vendors and Camp Allies do not sell raw or cooked Scorchbeast pieces. However, some players will sell the meat to the Watoga Vendors after a Queen so it can be worth checking their inventory.

**Cranberry Meatball Grinder**

Whitesprings Restaurant - 26.14%

__Grandma Junko__ - 19%

**Scorchbeast Mixed Meat Stew**

__Scorchbeast Nests__

Scorchbeast Nests are part of your pick-up history list. If you don't know what that means, then have a read over this __guide__ and then come back. 

Butcher's Bounty and Backwoodsman 1 magazines do not work on Scorchbeast Nests.

Drop Rates:

- Scorchbeast Brain - 20% chance
- Scorchbeast Liver - 20% chance
- Scorchbeast Heart - 20% chance
- Scorchbeast Meat - 20% chance
- Scorchbeast Lung - 20% chance

**Watoga Municipal Center**

5x Scorchbeast Nests

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b51f6c1de8e74b0fae7ec43e5be9a776~mv2.jpg)

You will need to enter the building and work your way to the top to check these nests, however, there are also 4 rare coloured baseball bat spawns in this building. If you follow the route for the 4 __baseball locations__ in there, then it will also get you to the top of the building. 

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_417affa5353d410b9393f23ed277a091~mv2.jpg)

**Watoga Civic Center**

3x Scorchbeast Nests

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_07f253785bac48f28330d56f6000aef2~mv2.jpg)

The roof of the civic center can be accessed from the outside. There will be some Super Mutants with miniguns and mutant hounds up here.

There are 2 nests in the area marked with a 1, you just have to very slowly move your cursor around to catch the one underneath.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_61fd61d91bf145ebbc8017c5467e6dc7~mv2.jpg)

**Vault 96**

1x Scorchbeast Nest

This is the same location that you visit for the settlers during the __New Arrivals__ questline. 

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_7014013a251c4a758392c5c716779bb4~mv2.jpg)

When facing the Scorchbeast corpses, turn North and walk straight until you get to the edge of the cliff. Look down and slowly walk back towards the Scorchbeast corpses, you will see the nest on the ledge below you.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_3dde7ce1173e4daa81a7ecebc9a8e557~mv2.jpg)

__Scorchbeasts Corpses__

These are corpses placed in the game, not to be confused with the corpses of Scorchbeasts killed by other players.

Scorchbeast Corpses are part of your pick-up history list. If you don't know what that means, then have a read over this __guide__ and then come back. 

Butcher's Bounty and Backwoodsman 1 magazines do not work on Scorchbeast Corpses.

Drop Rates:

- 50% chance for the corpse to be empty
- Scorchbeast Brain - 20% chance
- Scorchbeast Liver - 20% chance
- Scorchbeast Heart - 20% chance
- Scorchbeast Meat - 20% chance
- Scorchbeast Lung - 20% chance

__Fissure Sites__

Fissure Sites will spawn one Scorchbeast every 18 minutes.

If you run the below route, then the first fissure site will be ready to spawn another Scorchbeast by the time you have cleared the last location.

__How to build and use an MTU__

If you are new to the Wasteland and struggling to complete challenges or need to hunt large amounts of Scorchbeast parts and don't want to use up all your ammo, then using a Mobile Turret Unit may be of assistance.

You may need to shoot at the Scorchbeast a few times and lead it over to your MTU so it is within range of the turrets.

Remember to get some tags on the Scorchbeast before it dies, so you can loot it afterwards.

Be discreet when using these. Try and only use them on private servers.

You will need:

- An empty camp slot
- Flamethrower Trap
- Perk Card - Contractor Rank 2
- Perk Card - Home Defense Rank 3

**Step 1**

Build one Concrete Foundation.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_660e400c516740f5bc014bad6da1d5d3~mv2.jpg)

**Step 2**

Build one set of Stairs.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_2af1eb58b1624e63bda0c3576d2c2c48~mv2.jpg)

**Step 3**

Build one Wood Upper Floor and attach it to the top of the first set of stairs.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_28e67a9e7d384b72943c778215158f44~mv2.jpg)

**Step 4**

Build four Half Wood Upper Floors, two on each side of the Wood Upper Floor.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_cbe648b5be9f4bc0afd9bba9c87fa141~mv2.jpg)

**Step 5**

Build a Utility Box Generator - Fusion in the middle of the Wood Upper Floor.

You can use any Generator, as long as it fits on the Wood Upper Floor and produces 20+ power.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_68ad9da26b644c769e0dca8595a01603~mv2.jpg)

**Step 6**

Build three Wall - Halfs around the generator.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_7b6b6f0a73db4ab18d95c5dfff908251~mv2.jpg)

**Step 7**

Use the Flamethrower Trap to destroy the walls and the generator.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_110fbf595b884b36916bf9a87d69119b~mv2.jpg)

**Step 8**

Build a second set of Stairs.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0a0142f5f2504ebd8a9509c25e64f8b4~mv2.jpg)

**Step 9**

Build one Half Wood Upper Floor and attach it to the top of the second set of stairs.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_599e69f25a2e4989912c71efd3ea3fed~mv2.jpg)

**Step 10**

Build four Half Wood Upper Floors, two on each side of the Half Wood Upper Floor.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0e5369a932ee453dbdd00c4698495ebc~mv2.jpg)

**Step 11**

Build two Daring Heavy Cryo Turrets, one on each end of the top row of Half Wood Upper Floors.

If you don't have the Daring Cryo Turrets unlocked, two Heavy Machinegun Turrets or two Heavy Laser Turrets will also work here.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b2f11c8f464f4e6184bdd8fc0f4adc5d~mv2.jpg)

**Step 12**

Build Conduits along the back of each floor level. Try and keep in mind where the Turrets will be placed when you are placing the conduit. Run the conduits as far back on the floor as you can.

You can place the conduits any way that you like, just keep in mind that they can be damaged so keep them as clean and neat as possible.

You can just connect the Turrets to the generator by using wires but it makes the MTU look messy and if one Turret breaks then you have lost use of all the Turrets.

You will need to use the proper conduits that go through walls to connect the bottom row of Turrets to the generator, otherwise you won't be able to place the MTU in the future.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_634d50c2217b455a87ab572b8ac6492f~mv2.jpg)

**Step 13**

Build eight Enclave Polished Steel Heavy Laser Turrets.

Place four on the bottom floor and four on the top floor, evenly spread out as in the picture.

Make sure they are all facing one way. Ideally, they need to be facing away from the stairs.

If you do not have either of the Enclave Skins for your turrets, then the standard Heavy Laser Turrets will work fine.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_7e360a35eb704ec2af18757a6c05bd4f~mv2.jpg)

**Step 14**

Repair **__just the generator__** and connect the conduits and wires to the generator. 

**Step 15**

Make sure all the turrets have power and are moving. Once you are happy that everything is working then find your CAMP module and repair all.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_61c40f5cee1e485889d71809f5f6457b~mv2.jpg)

**Step 16**

Take your MTU out for a test drive and make sure that you can place it.

**Step 17**

Fast travel to all marked Fissure Sites on the map, place your MTU, and start farming.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5f34270fb75840c8921df74897b29dd0~mv2.jpg)

**Additional Tips**

Once you have built your MTU and it won't place, it's either a camp item or poorly placed conduit. You will need to scrap the MTU and rebuild it.

If you are not a combat-ready player, you may need to repair the turrets mid-battle. I recommend placing the CAMP module near the base of your MTU where you can find it quickly and easily.

Build a traveling workshop on one foundation. Keep it simple and avoid skins as they may not place.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_cd3036bf08dc47089caf574c0f95d56e~mv2.jpg)
